description: This file defines a data access layer class ('NotesRepository') that facilitates CRUD operations for notes in a database, abstracting SQL operations via SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to perform CRUD operations on notes stored in a database.

methods.name: None __init__(self, engine: Engine)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a SQLAlchemy engine.

methods.name: int count_notes(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of notes in the database.

methods.name: list[NoteORM] list_notes(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by 'updated_at' descending, then by 'id' descending.

methods.name: NoteORM|None get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a note by its unique identifier.

methods.name: NoteORM create_note(self, title: str, content: str, now: datetime)
methods.description: Creates a new note with a given title, content, and timestamp.

methods.name: NoteORM|None update_note(self, note_id: int, title: str, content: str, now: datetime)
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by 'note_id' with new title, content, and timestamp.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returning True if successful.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_note(self, title: str, content: str, now: datetime) -> NoteORM:$/
ctags.signature: (self, title: str, content: str, now: datetime)

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_note(self, note_id: int) -> NoteORM | None:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_note(self, note_id: int, title: str, content: str, now: datetime) -> NoteORM | No/
ctags.signature: (self, note_id: int, title: str, content: str, now: datetime)
